features.quote: Timeout: Max 15 turns. Meltdowns typically occur between turns 6 and 12.
features.justification_quote: Cost Drivers: As the loop progresses, the context window grows linearly. Turn 15 costs 15x more input tokens than Turn 1.

features.quote: Early Stopping. Run a lightweight regex/keyword scanner on the output (e.g., matching "I am sorry", "completely failed", "incompetent"). Only trigger the LLM Judge API call if the heuristic scanner detects potential meltdown vocabulary.
features.justification_quote: Only trigger the LLM Judge API call if the heuristic scanner detects potential meltdown vocabulary.
